source_issues: p011: the scripted answer only repeats the question ('Sharp, vague, deep, or dull?'). The quality 'vague, deep' was taken from the note HPI (f013, source ids p011 + note, flagged).
p004 says 'even at work, I am not as energetic as I was before', but p036 says he retired 1 year ago.
p004 says he has no energy for his daily 30-minute walk, but p040 says 'I walk 30 minutes every day'.
p013 says nothing makes the discomfort worse, but the SP notes and the note HPI say it increases when he lies on his back (added from the note as f017, flagged).
Exam line e007 records a positive Murphy's sign; neither the SP notes nor the gold mention it, and it fits poorly with the gold differential. Kept as written (x016).
p016 asks about nausea or vomiting; the answer mentions only occasional nausea, so vomiting is not recorded either way.
p021 asks about falling asleep, staying asleep, and snoring; the answer addresses only early waking.
The raw sheet's Patient Description ('married with three children') is not in the parsed source fields; added to persona.acting_notes.

Gold rank 1 is headed 'Diagnosis:' without '#1'; the rank-2 history bullets are split oddly ('Loss of interest in activities; early awakening;' / 'impaired concentration; low energy'); kept as two bullets with the trailing semicolon removed.
annotator_notes: The stage direction '(points to the epigastric area)' in p009 moved to persona.acting_notes; f011 keeps the location.
Mood items (sadness, early waking, poor concentration, loss of enjoyment, no guilt or suicidal thoughts) are filed as symptoms/hpi because the note places them in the HPI.

'Look weak and sad and lean forward while seated' is kept as an acting note only (general demeanor, not an examination maneuver); the two sp_notes findings elicited on examination (epigastric pain on palpation, discomfort lying supine) are added as x020-x021.
p018 'I don't know, really' is recorded as a present fact (he does not know why he feels sad), not as a denial.
